subject: Regional residency guardrails & runbook — architecture review scheduling
messages:
From: Martin Cole <martin.cole@acme-corp.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-region residency deep-dive — request and constraints

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Our security and platform teams at Acme reviewed the initial runbook and want to follow up with a technical architecture deep-dive focused on EU/US/APAC residency guardrails and how Redwood would handle regional routing, KMS scoping, and cross-region failover.

High-level asks for the session:
- Walk through network topology options (VPC peering vs. private link) for private deployment.
- Explain how key material and audit logs are scoped per-region.
- Show failover behavior and SLA tradeoffs between Hosted vs. Dedicated capacity.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute session next week? Timezone constraints: EMEA team prefers mornings (CEST), APAC can join afternoons (AEST). I’ve attached our suggested agenda.

Appreciate it — Martin

---
Attachment: 2027-06-20_acme_agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Martin Cole <martin.cole@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-region residency deep-dive — request and constraints

Martin — thanks for the clear asks and the agenda. We should be able to cover all bullets in a 75-minute session if we keep to the timeline; I’ll lead the infrastructure/serving runtime pieces, Vivek can cover routing and failover, and Karthik will walk through residency controls (KMS/Audit).

Proposed slots (CEST / AEST windows in parens):
- Wed, Jun 23 — 09:00 CEST / 17:00 AEST (preferred)
- Thu, Jun 24 — 08:00 CEST / 16:00 AEST
- Fri, Jun 25 — 14:00 CEST / 22:00 AEST (late for APAC, not ideal)

Please let me know which of these works for your broader team. I’m attaching a draft runbook and a matrix that maps residency requirements to deployment options. We can update the runbook live during the call.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 02:14:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Multi-region residency deep-dive — request and constraints

Thanks Priya — Wed, Jun 23 at 09:00 CEST works for our EMEA security folks. APAC will have a partial overlap but can join the recording. Can you reserve a 90-minute block just in case? Also, please include the following in the agenda:
- Demonstration of KMS key scoping per-tenant and per-region.
- Example audit logs (retention and export controls).
- What happens to session affinity and KV caches during cross-region failover.

If you can, add a short pre-read section in the Confluence link so our SREs can skim before the session.

Martin

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Martin Cole <martin.cole@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-region residency deep-dive — request and constraints

Martin — I’m looping in some small changes on timing. Priya flagged a scheduling conflict with a Dedicated capacity review that overlaps her calendar for Wed morning. Two options:
1) Keep Wed 09:00 CEST and I’ll run the session (I’ll cover architecture and routing; Priya will join the first 30 mins for handoff).
2) Move to Thu 08:00 CEST and have the full Redwood team for the whole 90 minutes.

Which do you prefer? If you want the full cross-functional team (Karthik + Vivek + Priya end-to-end), option 2 is better. If you need it earlier, option 1 will work and we’ll follow up with a short focused session on KMS/keys the next week.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Laura — thanks for the heads up and for offering the options. Given we want KMS scoping and the full end-to-end walkthrough with SREs in the room, please go with option 2 (Thu, Jun 24 — 08:00 CEST). Can you send a calendar invite with Zoom and the Confluence pre-read pinned? Also please include an agenda with timeboxes and who will speak to each section.

I’ll make sure the EMEA security lead and APAC SRE join; APAC will watch the recording if timezone coverage is limited. Looking forward to the session.

Martin Cole
Senior Security Architect, Acme Corp
martin.cole@acme-corp.com
